title: The NNNC reference rebuilt on the model-free width book: the ARO p_buy sizer (and tr_scale) on w_free's entries
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test; the late half is NOT blind (cs_aro / cs_aro_tr were read on the same folds). Committed before any threshold is picked or any arm is built or run.
why: user request 2026-10-25, after w_free replaced w_aro as the width yardstick: cs_aro / cs_aro_tr size w_aro's entries, whose cuts are matched to the ARO model's entry count. Rebuilt on w_free, the reference's entries read no model; the model only sizes.

cs_free.class: NNNC_CS_FREE = NNNC_CS_ARO with WIDTH_CUTS = NNNC_W_FREE.WIDTH_CUTS (nothing else changes: WidthSizerMixin AGREE_RULE p_buy, AGREE_SHARE 0.5, STAKE_WEIGHTS (1.0, 0.5) -> 1.333x / 0.667x, the control ARO weights; model key asserted == NNNC_CS_ARO's)
cs_free.thresholds: re-picked per fold, one process each, by research/control_sizer/pick.py --plan plan_cs_free.json (first bar of each width-book run in the fold's validation tail -- now w_free's runs --, (1 - 0.5) quantile of p_buy, 4 dp); --verify every fold (tag mismatches 0, loaded == stored)
cs_free.pass: judge_one(cs_free, w_free) PASS AND judge_one(cs_free, wf_aro_g24) PASS -- the cs_aro rule (research/control_sizer/preregistration.json) with w_free as the width book

cs_free_tr.class: NNNC_CS_FREE_TR = TrScaleMixin over NNNC_CS_FREE with NNNC_CS_ARO_TR's settings (TR_UP_CELL up_pair_96, TR_DOWN_CELL down_pair_672, TR_SOURCE standin, TR_STANDIN_ROOT transition_v2; the same fitted stand-ins)
cs_free_tr.thresholds: cs_free's (copied; the agree pick does not read the stand-in)
cs_free_tr.pass: judge_one(cs_free_tr, cs_free) PASS (tr_scale carries to the rebuilt book)

rule.judge: research.nnnc_switches.judge.judge_one: early gain > 0, late gain > 0, paired not WORSENED, risk (Sharpe, maxDD) not WORSENED, maps below; INCONCLUSIVE if the control has < 200 pooled trades or no fold changed
rule.small_margin_rule: if any half gain of a PASS is < 1 pp, it is INCONCLUSIVE until a seed-2 repeat (ARO seed-2 legacy weights, the cs_aro_s2 classes' -- already trained; thresholds re-picked at seed 2; wf_aro_g24 seed 2 as recorded; w_free seedless): every margin > 0 on both seeds

instrument.entries: cs_free's trade set == w_free's on (pair, open_date, close_date) in all but <= 2 folds (the sizer changes stakes, not entries; the shared wallet can move a few); cs_free_tr vs cs_free the same
instrument.tags: pick --verify on all 15 folds: 0 tag mismatches, loaded == stored
instrument.capital: mean stake ratio cs_free / w_free within +-10% (capital-neutral sizer)

reported_beside: DESCRIPTIVE: cs_aro (59.95) and cs_aro_tr (65.35) by half and paired per fold vs cs_free / cs_free_tr
adoption: the user's call. If both arms PASS, cs_free_tr is the candidate to replace cs_aro_tr as the NNNC reference (and live_fold's --book default).
